text: The best dental clinic in Thailand. All dentists are the best. Superb service and very clean. I’ve been receiving dental treatment here for the past three years, and every dentist here is excellent. I had my orthodontic treatment done here, had my wisdom teeth removed, and regularly get scaling done. My family also had her root canal treatment here.

I like this dental place because the dentists where really kind, they where gentle and they where fast.

I like the way the place is decorated, it is very aesthetic, kid friendly and also provides water!
The dentist is very kind and attentive. I was here for the consultation and I was given great advice. Will be back for follow up after 3 months. Thanks for taking care of me ❤️ Nice decoration also
Great staff and facility! But best of all, the dentists are super nice and good at their job! Very light and gentle with their hands so was a very comfortable experience!
I had an excellent experience at MDK Dental Clinic. The staff and dentists were friendly and very professional. The clinic was very clean and well equipped. Highly recommend.

The doctors here is very meticulous in details, especially the root canal treatments. The standard of hygiene is excellent. After Covid period, they sanitize the room for every patient. It’s the go-to place of dentist for my whole family.

Very professional and gentle! The dentist explained the whole procedure properly and kept checking on me. Years of tartar buildup cleaned up efficiently!
Thank you very much 🙏 …

Truly the ultimate dental clinic.
All professional dentists and staffs are very helpful and provide kind support always.
Been treated here for over 5 years. Great service, clean place, friendly staff, and the doctor is willing to give advice.

I have been a patient of Dr. Jeerapat for over a decade, and I can confidently say that she is the best root canal specialist I’ve ever had the pleasure of seeing. Her diagnostic skills are outstanding, and her approach of treating tooth pain and infected pulp is both precise and effective. Throughout the years, she has successfully handled even the most complex cases with remarkable care and expertise.

Dr. Jeerapat is incredibly meticulous, with a wealth of experience that is evident in the quality of her work. The team at MDK Silom Clinic is equally exceptional-always professional, friendly, and attentive to patient needs. I highly recommend Dr. Jeerapat to anyone seeking top-tier dental care.
Excellent doctor and  clinic in town.
Excellent dentists with friendly staff. I have been coming here for more than a decade and plan to continue.

Can't say anything about doctor's professionalism, but the service is awful.
I have come to clinic with urgent case and ask if doctor is available for consultation. The staff have asked to wait for 5 minutes. Half an hour later I was informed that doctor can't receive me but can do that at 8 pm. Ok, no problem.
I have come to clinic at 7.55 pm and... It was closed. So I have spent my time twice for nothing (and it was very important for me to get conclusion for my case today because of impact to my next travel location). What can I say... no one cares here.

text: Had my teeth cleaned and very satified. Fast and efficient service.

I was recently in Bangkok on holiday and found myself needing emergency root canal treatment. I was lucky to be staying in Silom, close by to MDK. I visited without an appointment and I again was lucky enough to be able to. See Dr Alisa Leesavan and her wonderful assistants I can't thank Dr Alisa enough for the emergency work she did on my tooth. Her emergency work allowed me to fly back to Sydney to the next day without any pain. I have no hesitation in recommending this dental practice as they do very good work .
Very professional doctor, right price.

I can't recommend enough the service of Dr. Jeeraphat for endodontic treatments.
I had to do a root canal treatment for the second time on my tooth 45 following a new infection 10 years after my first treatment. And I am so grateful to have been recommended her service by another endodontist in Bangkok, as my case was looking very complicate on the X-Rays.
Dr. Jeeraphat delivered an incredible attention to my case from the start to the end. She has such an experience in endodontic treatments and emits a positive and soothing energy which made me relaxed and worry free throughout the treatment.
All in all, such an unmatched experience.
My wife happened to have to do as well a second canal treatment on another tooth, and she felt the same about Dr Jeeraphat.
Special mention for the caring staff accompanying Dr Jeeraphat and in the clinic. The communication was always easy through the Line chat of the clinic.
Highly highly recommended
